record.oneLiner: MrScraper provides AI-powered web scraping and data extraction via a REST API authenticated with API tokens, offering a free tier and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
record.verdictReason: MrScraper provides a fully documented REST API with broad platform and scraping endpoints, self-serve credentials available immediately upon signing up for their free tier, and an official MCP server provided by the vendor.

evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints. Every request must include a valid API token in the HTTP request headers.
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
Comprehensive documentation for MrScraper's API endpoints, including authentication, pagination, error handling, and scraper management.
Official MrScraper MCP server: Scraper API for HTML, Markdown, and screenshots, web search, and account usage for AI agents.
